sentences.text:
Tulana Nandan & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 1
December, 2025
01.12.2025
Ct. No.42
M/L 65
Mujahid
 Crr 969 of 2025
 Tulana Nandan & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Bhaskar Chakraborty
 Ms. Joyee Maity
 Mr. Surajit Maity

1.
Present petition has been filed for expeditious disposal of G.R. Case No.5041 of 2012 arising out of Ashoknagar P.S. Case No.523 of 2012 under Section 498A/34 IPC pending before the learned Additional Judicial Magistrate, Barasat Court, North 24 Parganas.
2.

entities.text: Additional Judicial Magistrate, Barasat Court, North 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in the last 13 years, the case has not seen any progress.
The petitioners are stated to be senior citizen.
3. The court considers that no prejudice to be caused either of the parties if an appropriate direction is issued for the expeditious disposal.
The speedy and fair trial is a facet of fundamental right.

4. Thus, taking into account and facts and circumstances, the learned Additional Judicial Magistrate, Barasat Court, North 24 Parganas is directed to conduct the proceedings expeditiously in G.R. Case No.5041 of 2012 in accordance with the law.

entities.text: Additional Judicial Magistrate, Barasat Court, North 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. Accordingly, CRR 969 of 2025 stands disposed of.
6. All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
